name: Kitaakita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitaakita city emblem in green and orange: a green stylised swirl of leaves with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kitaakita, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 3 October 2005.

features.role: Kitaakita city emblem — a green stylised swirl of leaves with an orange disc
